gold_description: Soon Available. The functionality for "Soon available" is missing. This is used in requirement 3.1.8.
Prioritise orders. It is not possible to prioritise and order. Requirement 3.2.3.

Estimated time. The information about "Estimated time" to be available  in the signal "confirm". The operator shoudl be able to estimate the time when a taxi will arrive to a customer. Requirement 3.2.3.
Cancel order. The signal "Cancel_Order" is missing. Requirement 3.2.4 is not fullfilled. No message to the operator. (4.1  in  STLDD). Manuel dispatch and cancel order.
Confirm Order. A ??taxi driver/operator?? cannot confirm an order. This fault is present on many places.
Bill. There is no signal to send the price to a taxi driver. It is also not possible to print out receipt.
Log in. The operator cannot log in to the system and does not get a message when/if he/she has been logged in.
Available is missig. The signal "Available" is missing, The cars do not tell the central when it is available after drivinga custoimer. The car should have send available.
Taximeter signals. The signals "meter_on" och "meter_off" are missing between the taxt module and the central. The central should know when the taximeter is on and off.
Start alarm is missing. The signal "start alarm" is missiing.
Indicate alarm. A signal to indicate an alarm is missing from the central to the operator. An alarm  signal between taxi and central is also missing.
Reject Orders. A signal is missing for not confirming orders.
ZoneInfo. A signal to send zone info is missing in section 3.4.1.
